params.caption:
🎮 Rare just unboxed lost footage of Conker 64 — the cancelled N64 game that became Conker's Bad Fur Day!

Rare co-founder Tim Stamper posted a new YouTube video digging through archived studio documents, revealing:
• Concept art for "Twelve Tales: Conker 64" (revealed 1997), years before the mature-rated Bad Fur Day
• A 1998 dev build on an N64 cartridge, reportedly near-complete before being scrapped
• Hand-drawn level maps and enemy concepts, with an art style closer to Banjo-Kazooie than the squirrel's later foul-mouthed reboot
• Stamper says more "unboxing" videos are coming, possibly covering Diddy Kong Racing and Banjo-Kazooie too

🕐 Published: 01:09 AM GMT+3, Nov 27, 2026

📰 Sources: Video Games Chronicle - https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/rare-co-founder-reveals-footage-of-cancelled-conker-64/

👥 @Rare @Xbox

💬 Would you want to see the original Conker 64 fully restored and playable?
